children: Home improvement company Kingfisher is showing sequential improvement despite a weak consumer outlook, Deutsche Bank's Adam Cochrane writes. "With industry data points improving despite the macro overhang we see limited scope for a change to FY guidance at the 1H stage," Cochrane says. Deutsche Bank raises its fiscal 2027 pretax profit forecast 4% to 605 million pounds and has an estimate of 412 million on the metric for the first half. The bank raises its rating on the stock to hold from sell and its target price to 300 pence, from 260 pence. Shares are up 2.5% at 308.20 pence, but down 1.4% over the year to date. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
